title: Player currency: client said currency must not default to CAD; Jira calls the CAD fallback for a blank country 'working as designed'

jira.summary: Player Country/State missing on majority of SLC entries — driving unwanted CAD currency fallback
jira.quote: Our Player currency logic is working as designed: it correctly uses Country when provided, and only falls back to CAD when Country is absent. This was validated in the Sep 22 sync.

what_differs: On 08-27 the client said player currency 'definitely shouldn't default to Canadian'. Jira (WAGR-415) calls the CAD fallback for a blank country correct by design and says Jumpr needs no fix. WAGR-415 also reports that about 96.5% of SLCs have no country, so most players get CAD.
suggested_action: Decide the blank-country behaviour with the client: leave the currency blank and flag the player for review, or accept CAD until the CMS sends a country. Record the decision on WAGR-415 and WAGR-404, and keep the CMS country fix tracked.
